target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/shadow_frontier/notes && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode narrowband.tex >/tmp/nb.log 2>&1; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode narrowband.tex >/tmp/nb.log 2>&1; grep -cE "^!" /tmp/nb.log; pdfinfo narrowband.pdf | grep Pages; rm -f narrowband.aux narrowband.log narrowband.out
cd /home/john/mynotes && git add shadow_frontier/notes/narrowband.tex shadow_frontier/notes/narrowband.pdf && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
narrowband note: kink-structure remark; exact constants throughout

- New remark: the exact phase boundary eps*(D) is smooth except for
  corners exactly at window-size jumps 2D in Z (slope jumps -0.089 at
  D=1.5, -0.015 at 2.0, -0.020 at 2.5, gone by 3.5); delta-grid
  discretizations superimpose spurious scalloped structure (median
  |dtheta| ~ 0.02, up to 0.53 at small D) removed by exact states.
- Constants updated to certified values: D* = 1.246, band ratio 5.6,
  eps* ~ 0.54; figure swapped to the exact 2000x1500 vhires render.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
cd shadow_frontier && ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 2 --text "narrowband.tex updated: added Kink Structure remark (boundary corners exactly at 2D in Z, slope jumps -0.089/-0.015/-0.020 at D=1.5/2.0/2.5, decaying; delta-grid scallops identified as spurious, median 0.02 max 0.53); constants harmonized to exact values D*=1.246, ratio 5.6, eps*~0.54; figure now the exact vhires render. Closes the 'kink remark' NEXT item from the vhires capture." 2>&1 | tail -1 && ailog validate 2>&1 | tail -1
